name: Timothy Rothberg
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Timothy Rothberg, an attorney with Rothberg Shurtleff Dang PLLC in Houston, Texas, helps clients address Business Litigation situations. He also helps clients with Construction Litigation: Business concerns.
He received legal training from Emory University School of Law. He graduated from law school in 2005. Timothy Rothberg became licensed to practice law in 2006.
Timothy Rothberg was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2021 - 2026.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
